text.en: Gpts are gpts is row 76 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Evaluation Analysis area.
text.zh: Gpts are gpts 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 76 行，所属领域为“评测与分析”。

text.en: The annual table associates Gpts are gpts with “Gpts are gpts: An early look at the labor market impact potential of large language models”.
text.zh: 年度表把 Gpts are gpts 与论文《Gpts are gpts: An early look at the labor market impact potential of large language models》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Tyna Eloundou, Sam Manning, Pamela Mishkin, Daniel Rock”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Tyna Eloundou（官方页拼写）、Sam Manning（官方页拼写）、Pamela Mishkin（官方页拼写）、Daniel Rock（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Tyna Eloundou, Sam Manning, Pamela Mishkin, Daniel Rock”。
